text:
Olivia Chen: Auditor requested a combined evidence package covering RBAC changes, KMS usage, vuln triage notes, and any incident links for the 24h window on 2025-01-10. They want chain-of-custody for each RBAC change + KMS decrypt traces and a short mapping to any vulnerabilty patches that touched affected services. Thoughts on scope and redaction?
Samir Patel: I'd keep the scope tight: RBAC change events, SCIM provisioning deltas, k8s RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding changes, CloudTrail KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events, and a small CSV mapping changes -> PR/CHG ids. Redact PII, keep hashed principals.
Maria Gomez: Agree. For vuln triage, we can include vulnerability tickets (internal IDs) and the fix deployment timestamp. Do not export customer data. We'll provide CVE or internal vuln id but scrub stack traces.
Priya Rao: For incident linkage, include only incidents that had a direct authorization/role change impact. If we include incident tickets, strip any affected-customer identifiers and include a short redaction note.
Ethan Park: KMS side: export DescribeKey, GetKeyRotationStatus, and CloudTrail events where eventName in ("Decrypt","GenerateDataKey") and keyId matches the key ARNs under scope. Include requestId and encryptedDataKey bytes (base64) but never include plaintext.
AuditorBot: Please provide 3 representative end-to-end traces that tie: PR -> RBAC change (rolebinding) -> service account -> KMS Decrypt requestId. Auditor needs the chain. Redaction allowed for emails; keep stable hashed ids.
Olivia Chen: Good. Let's standardize on principal hashing: `user_sha256:<hex>` and `sa_sha256:<hex>` for service accounts. Keep timestamps in UTC.
Samir Patel: Example Splunk/Kusto-ish query I'll run (will adapt to each source):
```
(index=audit OR index=cloudtrail) AND (eventType=RoleBinding OR eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventType=SCIM)
| where _time >= "2025-01-10T00:00:00Z" AND _time < "2025-01-11T00:00:00Z"
| fields _time, eventName, principal, resource, requestId, requestParameters, responseElements
```
Maria Gomez: After export: 1) canonicalize timestamps to ISO8601 UTC, 2) replace principal emails with `user_sha256:...`, 3) create rbac_changes.csv (change_id, principal_hash, change_type, resource, pr_id, approver, timestamp), 4) kms_events.ndjson (one JSON-per-line with minimal fields).
Priya Rao: For vuln triage docs: create vuln_map.csv (vuln_id, service, fix_pr, fixed_at_utc, public_cve_if_any). Keep the description limited to one-line summary, no stack traces.
Ethan Park: We'll produce a signed MANIFEST.txt with SHA256 hashes for each file and GPG sign it with key `sec-audit@redwood`. We'll also timestamp the manifest and include the signer identity.
Samir Patel: Packaging plan: zip named `redwood_evidence_2025-01-10.zip`, manifest `MANIFEST.txt`, README.md describing filters + redaction policy, a small mapping doc `change_mapping.csv`, and a `sample_traces.txt` with the 3 anonymized end-to-end traces.
AuditorBot: Note: If you need to include any entries that reference customer PII, you'll need a signed LOA. Auditor will accept hashed identifiers for chain-of-custody instead.
Olivia Chen: Timeline? Auditor asked for delivery by EOD Thursday. Can we do that?
Maria Gomez: I can run queries tonight and drop raw exports into a secure bucket.
Ethan Park: I can gather key metadata and run the GPG sign after review.
Samir Patel: I'll assemble the mapping doc and run an internal spot-check checklist. Priya, can you take the vuln triage mapping?
Priya Rao: Yes, I'll pull from JIRA and the internal vuln tracker and produce vuln_map.csv by tomorrow morning.
Olivia Chen: Can we also offer a 20-30m walkthrough (screen share Splunk) for the auditor? They asked for a short live verification instead of a huge bundle if we prefer.
Maria Gomez: I'm available 910am PT Friday.
Ethan Park: 910am PT works.
Samir Patel: I can do 9:15.
Olivia Chen: I'll schedule 9:1500 PT and put the calendar invite; please attach the manifest SHA256 in the invite once signed.
AuditorBot: Confirmed. Please include the bundle presigned S3 URL and the manifest signature in the calendar invite reminder.
Samir Patel: Quick redaction rule we should document in README: 1) replace `email` with `user_sha256:<hex>`, 2) service account names replaced with `sa_sha256:<hex>`, 3) remove any `customer_id` fields unless LOA is provided, 4) keep timestamps and requestIds intact.
Priya Rao: Also include a short note on vuln severity mapping (critical/high/medium/low) and whether a compensating control existed at the time. One-liner per vuln is fine.
Olivia Chen: Great. Once the bundle is uploaded, post the presigned link and manifest hash here and I'll confirm with the auditor. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: 
Samir Patel: One more operational note: we'll rotate the presigned URL after auditor download and keep an internal access log of who downloaded the bundle.
Ethan Park: I'll attach the GPG signature and my public key fingerprint in the README for verification.
Maria Gomez: I'll start exports now and ping when they're in the secure bucket.
Olivia Chen: Thanks team 1:00. Update this thread when uploads are live.
